units.source_text: 匂亲王回到二条院，想起二女公子故意把浮舟隐藏，心怀怨恨，

en.t: Prince Niou returned to the Nijo residence and, remembering that the Second Princess had deliberately hidden Ukifune from him, felt resentful.

units.source_text: 因此不到她房中去而走进自己那间舒适的房间里躺下了。

en.t: So instead of going to her room, he went into his own comfortable chamber and lay down.

units.source_text: 然而无论如何也睡不着，独自寻思，痛苦难堪，终于心肠软了下来，走进二女公子房中去。

en.t: But he could not sleep no matter what he did; brooding alone in unbearable distress, his heart finally softened and he went into the Second Princess's room.

units.source_text: 二女公子心无挂碍，安详地坐着。

en.t: The Second Princess sat there peacefully, with nothing weighing on her mind.

units.source_text: 匂亲王一看，此人比起他最近看成稀世之宝的浮舟来，毕竟更胜一筹。

en.t: When Prince Niou looked at her, he saw that she was, after all, even finer than Ukifune, whom he had lately treasured as something rare beyond compare.

units.source_text: 而浮舟又非常肖似此人，便觉热恋满胸，痛苦不堪，走进帐中去睡觉了。

en.t: And because Ukifune so closely resembled her, his breast filled with burning love and unbearable anguish, and he went behind the curtains to sleep.

units.source_text: 二女公子跟着他进去。

en.t: The Second Princess followed him in.

units.source_text: 他对二女公子说道：“我心情非常恶劣！

en.t: He said to the Second Princess, “I am in a terrible state of mind.

units.source_text: 似觉寿命将尽，实甚可悲。

en.t: I feel as though my life is coming to an end, and it is truly miserable.

units.source_text: 我真心爱你，但一旦舍你而死，你必立刻变心。

en.t: I love you sincerely, but once I leave you behind and die, you will surely change your heart at once.

units.source_text: 因为那人蓄意已久，定欲达到目的。”

en.t: For that man has long been nursing his intentions and will certainly try to achieve his aim.”

units.source_text: 二女公子想道：“这种荒唐的话，怎么如此认真地说出？”

en.t: The Second Princess thought, “How can he say such absurd things so seriously?”

units.source_text: 答道：“你这话多难听啊！

en.t: She answered, “How unpleasant those words are!

units.source_text: 倘泄漏出去，被那人闻知，将疑心我在你面前说了什么话。

en.t: If they were to get out and that man heard of them, he would suspect that I had said something to you.

units.source_text: 真是太不成样了！

en.t: It would be utterly improper!

units.source_text: 我是身多忧患的人，听到你一句戏言，也要伤心呢。”

en.t: I am a person burdened with many sorrows, and even one joking word from you can wound me.”

units.source_text: 便背转身子。

en.t: Then she turned her back to him.

units.source_text: 匂亲王又认真地说：“假定我真个恨你，你将作何感想？

en.t: Prince Niou again said earnestly, “Suppose I truly hated you; how would you feel?

units.source_text: 我对你总算宠爱了，外人都怪我宠爱过分呢！

en.t: I have treated you with great affection, enough that outsiders blame me for loving you too much.

units.source_text: 但在你心中，恐怕我不及那人吧。

en.t: But in your heart, I am probably not equal to that man.

units.source_text: 这就算是前世因缘，无可奈何了。

en.t: If that is a bond from a former life, then there is nothing to be done about it.

units.source_text: 但你处处隐瞒我，叫我好恨啊！”

en.t: But you hide everything from me, and that makes me bitterly resentful!”

units.source_text: 此时他想起了自己对浮舟有前世因缘，终于寻着了她，不觉掉下泪来。

en.t: At this moment he remembered that he himself had a bond from a former life with Ukifune and had finally found her, and tears fell before he knew it.

units.source_text: 二女公子见他态度认真，心中不胜惊讶：不知道他听到了什么谣言？

en.t: Seeing how serious he was, the Second Princess was deeply astonished and wondered what rumor he could have heard.

units.source_text: 她只是默不作答，想道：“我当初原是受那人摆布而轻率地和他结婚的。

en.t: She only remained silent and thought, “In the beginning I was manipulated by that man and rashly married him.

units.source_text: 因此他处处疑心我和那人有暗昧关系。

en.t: That is why he suspects at every turn that there is something improper between that man and me.

units.source_text: 那人对我非亲非故，而我一向信任他，受他的照顾，确是我的过失。

en.t: That man was neither kin nor connection to me, and yet I trusted him and accepted his care; that truly was my fault.

units.source_text: 为此他就不信任我了。”

en.t: Because of that, he no longer trusts me.”

units.source_text: 她左思右想，悲伤不堪，那神情实甚可怜。

en.t: As she turned these thoughts over and over, she was overcome with grief, and her expression was truly pitiful.

units.source_text: 原来匂亲王暂时不把找到浮舟之事告诉她，而借别的理由来怪怨她，

en.t: In fact, Prince Niou was for the time being not telling her that he had found Ukifune, and was blaming her under another pretext.

units.source_text: 因此二女公子以为他是真心怀疑她与薰大将有事而说这种气话，她就猜想有人造谣。

en.t: Therefore the Second Princess thought he was saying such angry things because he truly suspected her of having an affair with Captain Kaoru, and she guessed that someone had spread a rumor.

units.source_text: 在没有水落石出之前，她见了匂亲王不免感到羞耻。

en.t: Until the truth came fully to light, she could not help feeling ashamed whenever she saw Prince Niou.

units.source_text: 此时明石皇后从宫中派人送信来了。

en.t: Just then Empress Akashi sent a messenger from the palace with a letter.

units.source_text: 匂亲王吃了一惊，立刻回到自己室中，脸上还带怒容。

en.t: Prince Niou was startled and immediately returned to his own room, his face still showing anger.

units.source_text: 但见明石皇后的信上写道：“昨日你不曾进宫，皇上甚是挂念。

en.t: Empress Akashi's letter said, “You did not come to the palace yesterday, and His Majesty is very worried.

units.source_text: 如果健好，望即入见。

en.t: If you are well, please come at once for an audience.

units.source_text: 我也久不看到你了。”

en.t: I too have not seen you for a long time.”

units.source_text: 他想起母后、父皇为他担心，自觉不好意思。

en.t: He thought of his mother and father worrying about him, and felt ashamed of himself.

units.source_text: 然而心情实在非常不快，因此这一天终于没有入宫。

en.t: Yet his mood was truly so miserable that in the end he did not go to the palace that day.

units.source_text: 许多高官贵族前来参见，但匂亲王一概挡驾，在帘内闭居了一天。

en.t: Many high officials and nobles came to pay their respects, but Prince Niou refused them all and spent the day shut away behind the blinds.
